questions.question: The distance between diffraction spots in a SADP is inversely related to:

answers.a: The wavelength of the incident electron beam
answers.b: The atomic number of the elements in the sample
answers.c: The real-space lattice spacing of the crystal
answers.d: The aperture size used in the TEM

questions.question: What does the presence of concentric rings in a SADP indicate?
Which of the following statements is true about the effect of dislocations on TEM SADP?

answers.a: Dislocations lead to the broadening of diffraction spots.
answers.b: Dislocations result in the formation of ring patterns.
answers.c: Dislocations do not affect the SADP.
answers.d: Dislocations cause spot splitting in the SADP.

questions.question: In a TEM selected area diffraction pattern (SADP) of cold-rolled aluminum, what characteristic feature is most likely observed due to deformation?

answers.c: Diffuse halos indicating an amorphous structure

questions.question: Cold rolling of face-centered cubic (FCC) metals like aluminum and copper often leads to which microstructural feature?
Which metal among aluminum, copper, and zinc is most likely to exhibit extensive twinning upon cold rolling?
Why does zinc show a greater tendency for deformation twinning compared to aluminum and copper?

answers.a: Due to its hexagonal close-packed (HCP) crystal structure
answers.b: Due to its face-centered cubic (FCC) structure
answers.c: Due to the presence of grain boundary precipitates
answers.d: Due to a high stacking fault energy
